item.title: Beloved 44-year-old pastor dies on New Year's Day after at-home accident
item.description: A beloved West Virginia pastor died on New Year’s Day while working on his pickup truck at home in Putnam County. #Pastor #death #SamPierson

item.title: Top responses to NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani's inaugural address: 'Godless, rancid ideology'
item.description: Democratic New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani drew backlash for his inaugural address, which he delivered from the steps of New York City Hall on Thursday after being sworn in on a Quran by democratic socialist Sen. Bernie Sanders. #ZohranMamdani #NewYorkCity #democraticsocialism #RobertBarron #XiVanFleet

item.title: Mom takes case against school that secretly socially transitioned her daughter to Supreme Court
item.description: A mother in Maine whose parental rights were usurped by school officials who gave her gender-confused daughter a chest binder and referred to her by using a male name and pronouns without her consent is taking her case to the U.S. Supreme Court. #Transgender #Maine #SupremeCourt #Parentalrights #Education

item.title: Trump warns Iranian regime not to shoot protesters: 'We are locked and loaded and ready to go'
item.description: President Donald Trump has warned the Iranian regime not to shoot peaceful protesters as citizens throughout that country participate in uprisings resulting from what the U.S. government has deemed “the mismanagement of the Islamic Republic of Iran.” #Iran #DonaldTrump #StateDepartment

item.title: Pastor’s widow sues HOA after neighbor’s persistent harassment escalated to murder
item.description: The widow of a pastor killed by a neighbor in 2023 in North Las Vegas, Nevada, has sued the homeowners' association and property manager, alleging they failed to prevent the escalating dispute that led to his death. #Murder #Killing #Shooting #Nevada #Lawsuit #PastorNickDavi #homeownersassociation

item.title: 73 million defenseless people were killed last year. Here’s why
item.description: More than 73 million abortions were performed worldwide in 2025, making abortion the leading cause of death last year. The figure draws on World Health Organization estimates compiled by the global data-tracking platform Worldometers. #Abortions #LeadingCauseofDeath #WorldHealthOrganization

item.title: Passion 2026: Cliffe Knechtle fields students’ toughest questions, from sexuality to God's existence
item.description: During a Passion 2026 session built around audience-submitted inquiries, Cliffe Knechtle, an American pastor and Christian apologist, addressed what organizers said were the most common questions young adults are asking today, questions about God’s existence, suffering, sexuality, morality and salvation. #CliffeKnechtle #LouieGiglio #Passion2026

item.title: Trump's week in review: Warning to Iran, Zelensky meeting, HHS probes Minn. daycare fraud
item.description: Before news broke in the early hours of Saturday morning about the Trump administration's strategic capture of former Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro during an early-morning raid, the president held joint press conferences with world leaders at his Mar-a-Lago residence in Palm Beach, Florida, to discuss various foreign policy issues. #Trump #Israel #Ukraine #Netanyahu #Zelensky #Minnesotadaycarescandal

item.title: Venezuelan Evangelicals respond to US capture of Maduro
item.description: Evangelical leaders in Venezuela and abroad reacted to the events with caution and calls for prayer. #NicolasMaduro #Venezuela #Evangelicals

item.title: Trump says US is 'going to run' Venezuela in wake of Maduro capture
item.description: President Donald Trump said during a press conference that the United States is "going to run" Venezuela in the wake of its capture of former Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro during an early-morning raid on Saturday. #Venezuela #DonaldTrump #NicolsMaduro #China
